findings: Stage 13 runtime repair: replay_lesson.replay_scope promises the frozen 94-turn base path, but mixed_execution stops as soon as 16 successes are reached. A replay can therefore terminate after only 16 mixed prompts (90 total base emissions), including when replay was triggered by failure in another phase, while the release predicate and accounting call it a 94-turn replay. Keep all 20 mixed prompts mandatory in the frozen base/replay path, or explicitly define a variable-length replay and update replay_scope, the 94-turn claim, remaining-budget predicate, accounting, and every dependent terminal rule together. The four comprehension demonstrations themselves are counted correctly as 12 actions: four REPLAY_TURN, four SHOW_OPTIONS, and four SHOW_CORRECT_OPTION emissions.

Stage 8 story-script repair, followed by Stage 11 visual rebinding and Stage 13 reassembly: pages 01-04 are a complete Taro/Ninereeds identity dialogue and pages 05-08 abruptly substitute Emma without a learner-visible transition, action, consequence, or shared goal beyond repeating the lesson forms. The operator-only assertion that one unresolved identity-verification chain spans the swap does not make the pixels or dialogue depict one coherent micro-event. Add a prerequisite-safe depicted development that connects Taro's departure/hand-off to Emma's arrival or redesign the eight pages as one visibly continuous interaction, then keep comprehension tied to that event.
